name: Chess Trainer
description: Personal chess trainer: Lichess games, Stockfish analysis, LLM coaching, drills, repertoire and a Maia-2 opening trainer.

STOCKFISH_PATH.description: Path to the Stockfish binary from the Aptfile package.

STOCKFISH_HASH_MB.description: Stockfish hash size in MB (eco dyno has 512MB RAM).

STOCKFISH_TIME_MS.description: Stockfish time limit per position in ms.

STOCKFISH_DEPTH.description: Stockfish analysis depth (kept low for the 512MB eco dyno).

STOCKFISH_MULTIPV.description: Stockfish MultiPV lines (1 keeps memory/latency low on eco).

MAIA_AUTO_FETCH.description: Auto-download the Maia-2 ONNX model + vocab on first opening-trainer use (Heroku eco has an ephemeral disk).

OPENING_PLIES.description: Number of opening plies kept for the opening trainer analysis.

LLM_API_KEY.description: LLM API key (OpenRouter or any OpenAI-compatible provider). Fill in after deploy.

LLM_BASE_URL.description: LLM base URL. Fill in after deploy.

LLM_MODEL.description: LLM model name. Fill in after deploy.
